latest.title: Desvendando Conteiners: A Receita para Aplicativos Portáteis e Eficientes.
latest.description:
De forma simples e didática, o conceito de contêineres na tecnologia, explicado como eles permitem empacotar aplicações com todas as suas dependências para garantir portabilidade, consistência e eficiência em qualquer ambiente.

Além disso, o texto explora as ferramentas fundamentais como Docker e Kubernetes, e  como elas simplificam a criação, execução e orquestração de aplicações em escala.

latest.title: Building a Serverless DynamoDB MCP Server - Making Your AI Talk to Your Database
latest.description:
Built a fully serverless MCP backend on AWS that lets AI assistants interact 
with DynamoDB conversationally - using Lambda, API Gateway, IAM SigV4, and 
Terraform. Zero servers. Ten tools. One natural language prompt.

latest.title: Chicago Showed Up: A Recap of AWS Community on Tour

latest.title: Kubernetes at Scale with EKS Auto Mode: One Click to Production AI
latest.description: Amazon EKS Auto Mode lets you go from zero to a production-grade Kubernetes cluster with a single click. No infrastructure expertise required. trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
